quarterly_data.signal: Korean subsidiary Nippon Sanso Matheson Korea (NSMK) built a new semiconductor material gas plant (Inju Plant) in the Inju district of Asan, South Chungcheong Province, Korea, held its opening ceremony and started operation on September 3, 2026. It follows NSMK's existing Eumbong plant in the same city and will produce and supply semiconductor material gases led by diborane (B2H6) plus newly developed electronic material products; the company says the plant strengthens supply to meet rising demand from Korean semiconductor makers and has equipment in place for future business expansion.
